content: Darunavir and cobicistat should be taken with food to enhance absorption. Darunavir is approximately 95% protein-bound, while cobicistat is 97-98% protein-bound. Darunavir undergoes extensive oxidative metabolism, primarily mediated by cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes, with CYP3A being the main enzyme involved. Cobicistat is metabolized by CYP3A and, to a lesser extent, by CYP2D6 enzymes. It does not undergo glucuronidation. The half-life of darunavir is approximately 7 hours, while the half-life of cobicistat is about 4 hours. For antiretroviral therapy (ART)-experienced patients, HIV genotypic testing is recommended to guide treatment decisions. However, if genotypic testing is not feasible, darunavir/cobicistat may be used in protease inhibitor-naïve patients. It is not recommended for use in protease inhibitor-experienced patients. Darunavir/cobicistat should be taken once daily with food to improve absorption. When comparing formulary status with other drugs in the same class, it is necessary to create a list of plans.
